Hi Ava / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team is preparing the DPA addendum and needs a current declaration of all third-party processors (subprocessors) that will touch OlivePay customer data when routed via Redwood. Specifically we need:

- An exported roster of subprocessors by function (storage, CDN, telemetry, KMS, analytics).
- Which subprocessors process data outside the EU and the countries involved.
- Any subprocessor changes in the last 90 days (additions/removals).
- A point of contact for SOC2 / security evidence (for KMS and telemetry providers).

We want to keep the DPA timeline tight — ideally review + redline this week. Can you provide a roster and any supporting evidence? If you already have a standard redline, please send it over.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Vendor Risk
OlivePay

- SOC2: Redwood maintains an up-to-date SOC2 Type II report; we can provide the latest report under NDA or via a secure link.

- SOC2 Type II (latest) — we prefer a direct, time-limited secure link rather than an NDA PDF exchange.
- KMS vendor attestation (VaultEdge) — confirmation of HSM backing and key separation.

Can you confirm a target date for the final redline? We are aiming to complete DPA negotiation by EOD Friday 2028-11-24.

Appreciate the responsiveness.
